verdict.rationale: An incorporation registry could plausibly publish official SDKs, so this axis applies. The evidence shows only web filing (the Online Filing Centre) and PDF channels. The probe states the registry 'documents no transactional API on any surface checked,' and the keyless open.canada.ca CKAN API is a separate national open-data platform, not an official Corporations Canada SDK.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
